title: MultiMon
tagline: Cross-chain gaming containing dynamic 998 NFT's which changes with each chain's culture.Similiar to pokemon go with pvp and intresting mechanisms.
description: we solve the problems of NFT's being used in a multiple chain such that gaming computations can be transferred to less expensive chain while the security and richness can be preserved on main chains.
how_its_made: Transferring 998 dynamic nft data over to other chain's(thanks to hyperlane).Choosing the right theme which shows the problem we are trying to solve while tying up with bounties.
